name: Katharina Schmid
headline: PhD Candidate Visual Computing & AI @TUM
summary:
Hi there!
I'm Katharina, a tech enthusiast based in Munich. After earning my Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering and gaining five years of industry experience, I completed my Master's in Computer Science, where I focused on Machine Learning and Computer Vision research. 
Since June, I’ve been pursuing my PhD at the Visual Computing and AI Lab, supported by the MDSI Doctoral Fellowship. My research explores 3D generation and representation learning — aiming to push the boundaries of how AI perceives and creates the 3D world. Feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Student Researcher at the Institute for Computational Biology
positions.description:
- Developed and optimized data preprocessing strategies to enhance the integration of RNA sequencing data into a human blood atlas in Python
- Compared threshold-based quality control methods with a clustering-based approach to enhance low-quality cell identification

positions.title: R&D Engineer Air Intake Systems
positions.description:
- Led cross-functional, international projects as technical deputy to the team lead, responsible for costs, quality, and development approvals
- Developed fuel cell air filter technology and registered a patent creating measurable performance standards and lifespan criteria for adsorption filters in commercial vehicles
- Established new processes to ensure technical compliance with EURO VI certification and homologation
- Localized air intake components for production in China, ensuring quality standards through close collaboration with local suppliers
